triangulation.static_source: ELF x86_64 Capstone disassembly of games/server/linux-x64/libk2-x86_64.so (CHostServer::GenerateClientID @ 0x00CC8AA0), libgame_shared-x86_64-server.so (CPlayer::SpawnHero @ 0x00C99C90, CPlayer::RemoveBot @ 0x00C953A0, CPlayer::Terminate @ 0x00C98E90, CPlayer::Initialize @ 0x00C94A70, IGame::s_pGame @ 0x017CE960), and game-x86_64-server.so (CGameServer::AddBot @ 0x00104050, CGameServer::EndHeroLoading @ 0x000E4A40, CGame::SetupClientConnection @ 0x000A0ACE)
triangulation.dynamic_source: QueueArcadeSimulationTests protocol verification / native_guard unit tests + Linux hon-x86_64-server disassembly

counterevidence_searched: Evaluated whether Windows PE struct offsets could be carried over to Linux ELF binaries with a constant delta (-0x50 or -0x10); falsified by Capstone disassembly which proved non-uniform struct layout shifts: CPlayer::m_iClientNumber is shifted by -0xC (+0x9C on Linux vs +0xA8 on Win64), CPlayer::m_yFlags is shifted by -0x10 (+0x3CE on Linux vs +0x3DE on Win64), CPlayer::m_bMatchmakingPostInitialized and m_bIsBot are shifted by -0x18 (+0x650 and +0x653 on Linux vs +0x668 and +0x66B on Win64), while CPlayer::m_iAccountID (+0x2D0), CPlayer::m_pBotBrain (+0x730), CBotBrain::m_uiHeroIndex (+0x10), and IGame::m_pEntityDirectory (+0x28) have ZERO shift. Also searched for dlsym(RTLD_NEXT) interposition of CPlayer::SpawnHero and verified that K2 loads libgame_shared-x86_64-server.so via dlopen(..., RTLD_LOCAL), bypassing standard LD_PRELOAD interposition and requiring /proc/self/maps scanning and inline trampolines.
negative_control: Invalid IGame pointer (0xDEADBEEFULL) or unmapped unit address, intercepted by POSIX siglongjmp fault guard; non-arcade server instances (QueueArcadeMode == 0) executing zero trampolines; connectionless slot takeover attempt on already terminated player (flags & 0x0080); unprivileged IPC commands rejected by CmdSanitizer; and SafeMode/disarmed state cleanly bailing out without mutating CPlayer state.

obligations.description: Under -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti C++17 on Linux, provide a thread-local sigjmp_buf + sig_atomic_t armed guard (t_callFaultGuard) and kernel-validated pointer probing via process_vm_readv(getpid(), ...), integrated cleanly into the top of NativeGuardCrashSignalHandler in linux_native_guard.cpp so SIGSEGV/SIGBUS during an armed Queue Arcade operation triggers siglongjmp back to safe recovery without crashing the server or suppressing unarmed engine crashes.
obligations.thread_safety_invariant: Main server game thread only; NET_CHAT_GS_REMOTE_COMMAND and CGameServer frame loops execute sequentially on the engine main thread

obligations.description: Implement RTLD_LOCAL inline trampoline engine for Linux x86_64 DSOs: resolve module base addresses via /proc/self/maps scanning (FindModuleBaseByName), allocate executable trampoline pages within +-2 GiB near-jump range using mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0) followed by mprotect(PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC), copy displaced prologue instructions (min 14 bytes for FF 25 abs64 or 5 bytes for E9 rel32), write jump back to target + displaced_len, hook target function with mprotect + atomic 64-bit/instruction write, and flush instruction cache via __builtin___clear_cache.
